checks.name: managed anonymous JWTs have distinct authenticated principals
concurrent creation retries produce one conversation
guest B cannot read or claim guest A conversation
concurrent user retries remain idempotent and reject changed text
only server can save assistant text; concurrent retries save one atomic trace
feedback is guest-owned and cannot be forged by another user
real owner allowlist entry does not grant access before MFA
managed TOTP AAL2 grants the synthetic owner access
refresh retains guest identity and malformed JWTs are rejected
guest deletion cascades without deleting another guest conversation
expired conversations are hidden before the server retention purge
sign-out behavior is observed without assuming JWT revocation

limitations: Synthetic owner TOTP is not the human owner enrollment.
No backup restore, scheduled retention or browser session lifecycle qualification in this script.
